proven: Both async generation entry points run without importing any OpenAI SDK module; sync legacy APIs retain their worker-only SDK contract
TLS/client preparation stays off-loop and consent, configured endpoint, model and style are checked before prompt transmission and after model discovery
Streaming and nonstream requests never follow redirects or retry internally; native HTTP errors preserve structured authentication, quota and transient-network classification
SSE framing supports fragmented UTF-8, BOM, CR/LF/CRLF and multiline data; metadata/events/JSON and raw text are bounded, including escaped non-BMP codepoints
Terminal stop is mandatory; truncation, malformed protocol, premature EOF and text after finish never flush the unvalidated held tail as a complete answer
Repeated cancellation retains constructor, actual HTTP body and client close ownership; complete() no longer calls synchronous load() from the event loop
Nonstream usage metrics use validated provider completion_tokens only, never stale values or token guesses
The committed source-free CPython 3.13 artifact exercises native SSE and JSON completion outside the source checkout
limits_and_remaining: This removes the reproduced SDK cold-import trigger; it does not establish that the complete production heap can never trigger long process-wide GC pauses
No GC thresholds or collection behavior changed, no latency limit was widened and the existing shared-process conversation test was neither skipped nor moved to a separate process
H2 remains open for actual audio/capture/barge-in and the complete runtime acceptance; H4/H6 must evaluate remaining GC and native-worker lifecycle risks
